properties.name: mcp.api.token
properties.description: API token for MCP endpoint auth. Set via MCP_API_TOKEN env var.

properties.name: embedder.url
properties.description: Base URL for the Python ONNX embedder service. Set via EMBEDDER_URL env var. Default: http://localhost:8000.

properties.name: wrapper.url
properties.description: Base URL for the host-wrapper image processing service. Default: http://host.docker.internal:5001.
